description: This Java source file defines a final class 'ThingPredicateVisitor' which implements the 'CriteriaVisitor' interface for predicates applied to 'Thing' objects. It provides methods to visit different criteria expressions such as logical conjunctions (AND), disjunctions (OR), negations (NOR), existence checks, and field-based filters, constructing corresponding Predicate<Thing> implementations.

classes.name: ThingPredicateVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class for criteria expressions that constructs Java predicates to evaluate 'Thing' objects based on the criteria.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method that applies the visitor to a Criteria object and returns a Predicate<Thing> representing the criteria.

methods.name: visitAnd
methods.description: Constructs a Predicate<Thing> that evaluates to true if all conjunct predicates evaluate to true for a given 'Thing'. Overloaded to accept a List or Stream of predicates.

methods.name: visitAny
methods.description: Constructs a Predicate<Thing> that always evaluates to true, representing 'any' condition.

methods.name: visitExists
methods.description: Constructs a Predicate<Thing> that checks for the existence of a certain field as specified by 'ExistsFieldExpression'.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Constructs a Predicate<Thing> based on a field filter expression and an associated predicate for that field.

methods.name: visitNor
methods.description: Constructs a Predicate<Thing> that evaluates to true only if none of the provided predicates evaluate to true (logical NOR). Overloaded to accept a List or Stream.

methods.name: visitOr
methods.description: Constructs a Predicate<Thing> that evaluates to true if any of the provided predicates evaluate to true (logical OR). Overloaded for List and Stream inputs.
